Network Security

Virtueller privater Tunnel

A secure, encrypted connection established over a public or untrusted network, forming a logical link that protects data in transit between endpoints. Based on principles in NIST SP 800-77 and IETF VPN RFCs.

What is Virtueller privater Tunnel?

In this glossary, Virtueller privater Tunnel refers to: A secure, encrypted connection established over a public or untrusted network, forming a logical link that protects data in transit between endpoints. Based on principles in NIST SP 800-77 and IETF VPN RFCs.

How is Virtueller privater Tunnel used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Richten Sie einen virtuellen privaten Tunnel ein, damit Remote-Mitarbeiter sicher über unsichere Internetverbindungen auf das Firmennetzwerk zugreifen können."

Definition

A secure, encrypted connection established over a public or untrusted network, forming a logical link that protects data in transit between endpoints. Based on principles in NIST SP 800-77 and IETF VPN RFCs.
